rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for giving a reason or cause.

example.english: We changed our plans to see a movie owing to the rain.
example.traditional: 因為落雨，我哋改咗去睇戲。
example.jyutping: jan1 wai6 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 goi2 zo2 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal speech or writing when stating the cause of something.

example.english: The service was suspended owing to a system failure.
example.traditional: 由於系統故障，服務暫停。
example.jyutping: jau4 jyu1 hai6 tung2 gu3 zoeng3 fuk6 mou6 zaam6 ting4
